posts.text:
Monday, Nov 23: Toronto's streetcars lost 882 hours to delays, across all routes.

Slowest for its length: 511 Bathurst northbound. A typical 4.8 km trip lost 11 min (usually 11).
Smoothest: 504 King eastbound, 25 min over 14.9 km (usually 29).

#TTC #TransitSky #DataViz

https://stuckin.to/

Monday's slowest spot: Southbound on Spadina Ave, between Queen St W and Adelaide St W.
The average streetcar lost 2 min 12 s here (usually 1 min 46 s). Across 213 trips, that adds up to 7.8 hours.
The biggest share was at the Adelaide St W light, which has no transit priority.
posts.alt: 3D map of Spadina Ave around Queen St West, rotated to Toronto's street grid. Delay is drawn as a coloured ridge above the track, rising where streetcars lose time; the southbound stretch between Queen St W and Adelaide St W is highlighted, adding up to about 2 min 12 s lost per streetcar.

shot.title: Spadina Ave southbound, between Queen St W and Adelaide St W
shot.sub: Monday, Nov 23: 2 min 12 s lost per streetcar · 213 trips

posts.text:
Most short-turned, Monday, Nov 23: 510 Spadina. 1 in 5 trips (86) were sent back before the end of the line, most after Spadina Ave at Queen St West South Side (southbound, 56), instead of going on to Queens Quay.

Across all routes, 5% of trips were short-turned.
posts.alt: Map of the 510 Spadina route in the waits view: a column at each stop, taller and darker where riders waited longer than scheduled, and yellow warning signs where cars were short-turned. A tooltip on the busiest spot, after Spadina Ave at Queen St West South Side, gives how many southbound cars were sent back there instead of going on to Queens Quay.

posts.text:
Most held at a signal, Monday, Nov 23: westbound at Strachan Ave & Fleet St.

37% of streetcars waited 90 s or more beyond a clean approach, about a full signal cycle, despite transit priority.
About 299 streetcars came through.
posts.alt: Map of the streets around Strachan Ave & Fleet St, with arrows for each direction of streetcar travel into each signal, coloured by how often streetcars were held 90 seconds or more. A tooltip for the westbound approach reads 37% held 90 s+, with a histogram of extra time through the approach.

posts.text:
Monday, Nov 23: at the busiest moment (6:20 pm), 149 streetcars were in service, against 151 scheduled.
Overall, 99% of scheduled streetcar service ran, and buses ran 1,247 hours on streetcar routes.
posts.alt: Line chart of streetcars in service through Monday, Nov 23, every 10 minutes from 4 am, against the TTC's schedule (dashed). The busiest moment was 149 streetcars at 6:20 pm, against 151 scheduled; over the day 99% of scheduled streetcar hours ran.

posts.text:
Longest extra wait at a stop, Monday, Nov 23: Broadview Ave at Gerrard St East (504 King eastbound).

Riders waited 10.8 min on average, against 5.0 if cars had come as scheduled: 5.8 min extra. 28% of cars came bunched, and 20 of 132 scheduled cars never came.
posts.alt: Map of the streets around Broadview Ave at Gerrard St East in the waits view, a column at each stop. A tooltip for the stop reads 5.8 minutes of excess wait, with how often cars came bunched or with gaps, and a chart of the spread of gaps between cars.
